messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tirzepatide is a dual GIP/ GLP-1 receptor agonist, meaning it activates two gut hormone receptors that help regulate appetite, digestion, and blood sugar. It works by reducing appetite, increasing feelings of fullness, slowing gastric emptying, boosting insulin release when blood sugar is high, and reducing glucagon secretion.
Tirzepatide is self-administered as a subcutaneous (under the skin) injection using a single-dose pen, KwikPen, or vial with syringe, and should always be used together with diet and exercise.
Tirzepatide should not be used in people with type 1 diabetes. It is not known if tirzepatide is safe in people who have had pancreatitis.
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "reduces", "appetite"]

The relation 'reduces' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug decreases or lowers the level or intensity of the entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'helps reduce': The subject drug is used to decrease or lessen the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'reduces response to': The subject drug may decrease the effectiveness or response to the object entity.
C. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
D. 'has weak effect on': The subject drug has a minimal or limited effect on the process or entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'slows': The subject drug reduces the rate or efficiency of the process specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
